title: The 5 AM Club Embraces The Twin Cycles of Elite Performance
coreMove: Elite performance becomes durable when high excellence and deep refueling are treated as paired cycles rather than competing needs.

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders mistaking constant acceleration for excellence
exampleSpecs.stakes: achievement without refueling can produce collapse

exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use artist's block as creativity without renewal

exampleSpecs.stakes: rest can become a cover for never entering demanding work

exampleSpecs.audience: people treating the body like a machine
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use exertion plus recovery as adaptation

exampleSpecs.stakes: solitude can be crowded out by useful obligations
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Include solitude and nature in recovery philosophy

exampleSpecs.stakes: exam preparation can become depleted repetition
